name: collapsible-row
title: Collapsible Row
description: A list row that opens: a `ListItem` whose whole heading is `Disclosure`'s button (`aria-expanded`, a turning chevron), with the actions outside it and `contentSlot` under it, mounted only while open. The same box and words as the `ListItem` rows beside it, and no surface of its own. Controlled with `open`/`onOpenChange`.
